title: Chapter 1148
text:
During the closing ceremony, Flying Free and the other 'loyalists' took action. After that, almost all the army players stayed on the forums, concerned about the outcome of Flying Free and the others.

In the eyes of many neutral players, these people were reckless and impulsive. Even if they did not die, they would at least lose a layer of skin. Who knew how severe the faction punishment would be?

However, as soon as Fly Free and the others posted the private video, it immediately shocked many people. In an instant, it became a hot topic on the forums that tens of millions of people followed.

The recording completely recorded all of Han Xiao's performance in the private meeting. Seeing the Army Commander's confident and handsome appearance, the atmosphere on the forums suddenly changed and became one-sided praise.

Flying Free: From today onwards, the Army Commander is my big brother. Whoever dares to touch my big brother, I'll kill them! I'm done talking. Who agrees and who disagrees?

I'm the Northern God's Idiot: + 1 + 1

R 'yleh's Gaze: The Army Commander is too cool. It might be a little dirty … I'm boki!

Mecha Empire's Spinner: Although most of the time, it's not too much to say that the Army Commander's performance today is awesome, right?

Frog Sees Through Everything: Logically speaking, the success rate of these spies trying to shift the blame should not be low. At the very least, the army should conduct a thorough investigation. I didn't expect Black Star's judgment to be so amazing. He saw through the difference between the two groups of spies and dealt with the matter accurately and decisively. The ones with ulterior motives were banned, while you loyal subjects only received a symbolic punishment. The Army Commander's actions are quite something.

A Sick Name Is Idiot: As expected of the leader who has led the army for decades to reach this level … Brothers, I'm sorry! I can't go through the motions, I'm going to brag directly. The Legion Commander is simply a man of great talent and bold vision, wise and brilliant, handsome and elegant, knowing how to make good use of people, good at dancing, unfulfilled ambitions, besieging Wei to rescue Zhao, secretly plotting in Chen Cang, captivating the birds and beasts, beautiful and gentle … "

Tomorrow Won't Be Better: Aiya, I didn't expect the Army Commander to still remember us old buddies who have followed him since Version 1.0. My heart warms. Praise Black Star!

Bun-Hit-Dog: I'm a newbie who just joined in this version. Is the Army Commander actually such a charming person? He's practically a rare man in Galaxy. I love him, I love him. I'm going to watch Bun-Hit-Dog's Black Star videos right now.

I Love Dawn: Dog, remember to use a smurf account the next time you advertise as a newbie …

The video was uploaded to the forums as expected by Han Xiao. His goal of buying people's hearts was more than half achieved. This wave of actions was a combination of nostalgia, wisdom, and fair rewards and punishments. Not only did it give his image more of the so-called 'charisma of a leader', but it also increased the sense of faction identity of a large number of army players. This wave of feelings was enough to plant a seed in the hearts of many players, becoming another bond between them and the army.

Although Han Xiao did not deliberately explain his identity publicly, his few indirect actions had already washed away the players' doubts. At this time, the focus of the discussion on the forums was no longer whether Han Xiao was real or not but why Black Star had the Mecha Empire's ability.

All along, there had been rumors among the players that Black Star could copy and imitate the abilities of other characters in some way. Today, this rumor was finally confirmed.

As the saying of a Wuxia fan was widely accepted, Han Xiao also happily received a new nickname — Galaxy Murong Fu, Void Jiu Mozhi!

A large number of players believed that this special talent of Black Star was the important reason for his rapid growth. Using battle to nurture battle, constantly stealing … ahem, stealing ultimate techniques from his opponents.

In a sense, the guesses of the players were very close to the truth. However, guesses were still guesses. No matter how much they guessed, they would not know the specific situation of Han Xiao.

Furthermore, due to the lack of concrete evidence (for NPCs), this theory was only spread among the players. Even if it was spread to the outside world, it would not be very convincing to normal people.

Because Flying Free had single-handedly led this operation, he instantly became famous and was regarded by the players as the number one loyal officer of the army. He expressed on the spot that he wanted to reorganize the Black Star Fan Club and turn it into a regular team recognized by the army. He also expressed that he wanted to communicate with the army commander and form an Immortal Guards Army as his personal guards.

The forums were filled with joy. Other than praising Black Star, there were also many people mocking Winter Wolf and the others, crazily whipping their corpses.

Mario's Little Mushroom: Tsk tsk, some people just can't bear to see others doing well. They think of ways to drag you down and not let you develop well. They use some dirty and despicable methods, but instead of being ashamed, they are proud of it. Furthermore, they put on a sanctimonious face as if they are doing it for your own good. This is the best commentary for the word 'hypocritical'.

Big Smart: Got it. This is pointing at Black Star and scolding the Mecha Empire (laughing emoji).

Master Turtle Shell Bind: Hehe, it's a pity that our army commander is wise and cannot be deceived. Some people will probably lose everything (??? -) _]

However, in the midst of the mocking of the army players, the Northern Battlefront publicly jumped out and claimed that they were responsible for this matter. Instantly, a war of words broke out on the forums, drawing the attention of the players. What could they do? Compared to praising Black Star, scolding others was more interesting.

While the forums were in an uproar, the influence of the Black Star Cup was also fermenting in the galaxy. The fact that an army member had backstabbed Black Star on the spot attracted a lot of attention, attracting many galactic residents who were originally not interested in the topic. They started to look for the cause and effect of the incident with the mood of gossip.

Not long after the closing ceremony ended, Han Xiao made a public announcement to the entire universe in the name of the army, explaining this matter to the public and satisfying the curiosity of the spectators.

Basically, it was just adding details to Fly Free's public comments about the Mechanic Emperor, making the details more vivid and interesting. Then, it was published for the galactic residents to enjoy.

At the same time, the announcement also deliberately emphasized that the Mecha Empire should not be angry. This was just the true thoughts of others and did not represent the attitude of the army. They would always maintain respect for the Mecha Empire, even if he was a bad person. At the same time, they also hoped that the Mecha Empire would always maintain the heart of an elder and not bicker with the younger generation.

The galactic residents were still fine and were enjoying the show. However, the many Beyond Grade As who attended the event only had one sentence for Han Xiao in their hearts.

[Wow, you really don't have any integrity!]

We like it!

—

PS: The schedule for today's annual meeting is very tight. I have to attend all kinds of activities, and many of my old friends who I only see once a year have to gather. I only have a little free time to write. With my speed, I can only write this much today. Sorry, brothers, please forgive me (?????)
